summary: Prepare protected publication approval ruleset migration

delivery.outcome: Koru owns an independently reviewable ruleset 22026679 migration profile that requires one trusted exact-head approving review, drops the RepositoryRole(5) always bypass, retains the Validator App integration bypass, required OneDev/conformance checks and strict base verification, with readback verification, fork-scoped canary evidence, tested recovery and a documented remediation path for already-merged unapproved heads.
nonGoals: Modify, deploy or stage ruleset 22026679 on semcod/koru
Forge approval receipts or retroactively approve PR542, PR543 or PR550
Retire or weaken the OneDev, conformance or operating-system test requirements
Invoke the local Validator for this lane's own publication

architecture.decision: Store the exact PUT-able desired ruleset body as tracked code next to a read-only readback/verify/canary gate, validate the body and negative-merge enforcement on an operator-owned fork (production ruleset untouched), and defer the production PUT plus App-reviewed positive canary to the live deployment acceptance ticket.
architecture.rollback: No production effect exists; delete the tracked profile, gate and doc through independent publication if the migration is rejected.

validation.evidence: Desired-profile comparison, canary evidence validation and fail-closed behavior hold against the captured 2026-09-27 baseline and synthetic records.
Baseline readback reports exactly the approval-count, last-push-approval and RepositoryRole bypass gaps and preserves the OneDev/conformance checks with strict base verification.
Fork-scoped canary records validate: desired body round-trips to a conformant live ruleset, author/operator merge without review is rejected, and the ruleset recovery path restores the prior state.
Governance gate passes for the ticket scope and the change reaches main only through independent exact-head review.
